Package com.javaninjas.careerpathway.core.services

Class CacheMaintenanceService

java.lang.Object
javafx.concurrent.Service<Void>
javafx.concurrent.ScheduledService<Void>
com.javaninjas.careerpathway.core.services.CacheMaintenanceService
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.concurrent.Worker<Void>, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class CacheMaintenanceService extends javafx.concurrent.ScheduledService<Void>
Background service to periodically clean up expired cache entries. Runs automatically to maintain cache hygiene without manual intervention.
